description: This file defines the ActivationId struct, which uniquely identifies a grain activation in Orleans. It includes methods for creating, parsing, and comparing activation IDs, as well as JSON serialization support.

classes.name: ActivationId
classes.description: A readonly struct that uniquely identifies a grain activation, with methods for creation, comparison, and string representation.

classes.name: ActivationIdConverter
classes.description: A JSON converter class for serializing and deserializing ActivationId instances.

methods.name: ActivationId(Guid key)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ActivationId with a specific Guid.

methods.name: GetDeterministic
methods.description: Computes a deterministic ActivationId from a given GrainId.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the ActivationId.

methods.name: ToParsableString
methods.description: Returns a string that can be parsed back into an ActivationId.

methods.name: FromParsableString
methods.description: Parses a string to produce an ActivationId.
